description: This file defines a utility class for parsing, creating, and managing cache directives compliant with RFC 2616. It includes methods for generating max-age and no-cache directives, parsing directives from strings, and checking cache policies.

classes.name: CacheDirective
classes.description: A utility class for creating and parsing cache control directives such as 'max-age' and 'no-cache' as defined by RFC 2616.

methods.name: maxAgeDirective
methods.description: Creates a cache directive with a specified max-age in seconds.

methods.name: noCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns a cache directive indicating no caching is allowed.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Parses a cache directive string and returns a CacheDirective object if valid.

methods.name: isCachingAllowed
methods.description: Indicates whether caching is permitted according to this directive.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the maximum age in seconds for which a resource can be cached.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cache directive for use in HTTP headers.
